name: Article 18 – 15D
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: deleted Relationship with Directive 2009/81/EC The procurement contract of a Member State concerning any defence product resulting from an action supported under the Programme shall be considered as a contract awarded in the framework of a cooperative programme based on research and development as referred to in Article 13 (c) of Directive 2009/81/EC [following the adoption of Omnibus directive 2025/0177 (COD)].
